statement:
The record incorrectly lists the reviewer as recipient of a letter that names the authors.
The correspondence record for this case lists t.okonkwo@riverbend.edu as the decision-letter recipient even though the letter names the authors.
Decision letter mailed to the corresponding author.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "The record incorrectly lists the reviewer as recipient of a letter that names the authors," identifying the blinding breach and giving the correct recipient.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
